mechanic: Layered z-indexed hero stacking a looping background video, a warm overlay, an alpha-WebM bird mascot driven by a scroll-aware enter/idle/leave state machine, vw-scaled center brand wordmark, and a parallax sculpture image (translateY up) over scroll-pushed frosted-glass bottom panels, followed by a second video-backed centered-headline section.
techDelivery: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind (base reset only) multi-file component spec (main.tsx, App.tsx, Hero.tsx, Section2.tsx, index.css); all element styling via inline styles, react/react-dom/lucide-react deps (lucide declared but unused), no third-party animation library.
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in JSX markup (brand name, nav labels, headlines, CTA text). All icons are inline SVGs with hex/stroke colors baked in, not asset references. Hex and rgba values are inlined throughout rather than tokenized as CSS variables. The center wordmark is sized in viewport units (22vw/26vw) with negative letter-spacing, so swapping the display font shifts hero layout (font-metric-dependent). The bird mascot requires exactly four transparent WebM clips matching the enter/idle1/idle2/leave state-machine roles; fewer or non-alpha assets break the animation. Fonts are loaded from onlinewebfonts.com CDN (Zimula Trial Trial fonts), which must be replaced for a licensed reskin.
